subject: Urgent: Prioritization & customer comm lanes for model deprecation
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Prioritization & customer comm lanes for model deprecation

Team —

We need to lock a cross-functional decision this week for the scheduled deprecation of the rf-infer-v1 family (target EOL: 2027-06-30). BrightFinance (enterprise, committed) just flagged heavy usage of the last 6 months and is asking for a longer runway + a potential exception lane. I pulled together two artifacts and attached them: a proposed deprecation_timeline_v1.1.pdf and a comm_lane_matrix.xlsx that maps customer segments to comm approaches.

Asks:
- Product (Lauren): confirm whether the EOL date is firm or if we can offer a 90-day exception for enterprise customers that sign a mutual action plan.
- Engineering (Karthik): estimate the effort to keep rf-infer-v1 available behind a dedicated flag for BrightFinance for +90 days (rough cost in GPU-hours and risk notes).
- Sales (Marissa): share the expected impact on renewal cadence if BrightFinance requires the longer runway; include any open deals that will be affected.
- Legal/CS (Hannah): any compliance or contractual gotchas if we provide a time-limited exemption?

Goal is to have a single recommended path and comm lanes for SRE/Console to execute by EOD Friday so we can sync with BrightFinance next Monday.

Thanks —
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: aditya@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Prioritization & customer comm lanes for model deprecation

Aditya —

High-level position: the default EOL stays 2027-06-30. We can offer a controlled enterprise exemption (90 days) only under two conditions: (1) a signed mutual action plan (MAP) with timelines for migration, and (2) a cost-recovery surcharge for the extended runtime.

I'll own the MAP template and will attach a short checklist by EOD Wednesday. Quick notes:
- We should avoid blanket exemptions — they blow up product capacity planning.
- For BrightFinance specifically, if Sales confirms they will sign the MAP this week, we can move to approve.

I'll coordinate with Marissa and Legal for the surcharge language.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Product Roadmap
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, aditya@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Prioritization & customer comm lanes for model deprecation

Quick engineering readout:
- Keeping rf-infer-v1 online for BrightFinance behind a dedicated feature-flag + routing rule is feasible. Rough estimate: 3 engineers x 2 weeks to add the routing + testing + monitoring + an automated fallback if performance regresses.
- Ongoing cost: estimated additional 45 GPU-hours/day (assuming their peak usage profile). I'll convert to monthly $$ in the attached sheet.
- Risks: longer-term maintenance of kv-cache compatibility (we've got some brittle hooks in v1 that require manual cache invalidation). We can mitigate with a short-term shim but that adds operational toil to SRE.

If Product okays the 90-day exemption we can scope more precisely.

Karthik
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: aditya@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, sam.park@brightfinance.com
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Prioritization & customer comm lanes for model deprecation

Looping in a brief note from BrightFinance (copied) — Sam asked for a 120-day runway and said procurement will push for minimal operational changes. Procurement has also asked for a written comm lane and assurance that the API tokens won't change during the runway.

From: Sam Park <sam.park@brightfinance.com>
Sent: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Subject: RE: Model deprecation impact

Marissa —

Thanks. A 90-day extension is better than nothing, but our ops team is asking for 120 days to complete validation. Also procurement wants any exception in writing with clear timelines — they flagged token rotation as a blocker.

Sam
Principal Engineer, BrightFinance

Marissa (continued): From our renewal coverage: if we limit to 90 days without price protection, renewal probability drops ~30%. If we provide 120 days with a MAP and a small surcharge (~10% usage uplift covering GPU delta), renewal probability remains within 90–95%. Recommend we present both options to BrightFinance next Monday: (A) 90-day exemption with immediate surcharge, (B) 120-day exemption contingent on signed MAP + procurement acknowledgement on tokens.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: aditya@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Prioritization & customer comm lanes for model deprecation

Decision summary and next steps: per leadership, approved path is Option B (120 days) with these conditions:
- Sales/Customer: obtain signed MAP + procurement acknowledgment on token policy before any exemption is enabled.
- Finance: surcharge to be set at 12% to cover GPU delta and operational margin. Lauren, please finalize MAP template and include the surcharge language.
- Engineering: Karthik to run the dedicated flag work with an ops playbook for cache invalidation; target delivery: 2027-04-20 for a staging rollout, 2027-04-27 for production enablement.
- Comms: Aditya to coordinate a single executive-facing comm to BrightFinance + a technical runbook to their ops team.

Attachments: comm_lane_matrix.xlsx (detailed comm owners), deprecation_timeline_v1.1.pdf

I'll set a short follow-up on Wednesday to confirm MAP signed status.

Thanks all —
Hannah Schmitt
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
